ProviderCard.instruction: Create a horizontal card. Left: Avatar + Name + Specialty. Middle: 3 columns for Cost (display as bar chart/meter), Distance, Eligibility Badge. Right: 'Select' button. Highlight 'Savings' in Green.

CostChart.instruction: Use Recharts. Area chart with gradient fill. Tooltip must be custom styled (glassmorphism). Axis lines should be subtle (slate-200).

Layout.instruction: Sidebar navigation with collapsible state. Header with breadcrumbs and user profile. Main content area with max-width constraint for readability.

universal_guidelines: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case).
Do not use generic HTML inputs; use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Theme is predominantly light/white. Dark mode should be slate-900 based, not pure black.
Validation errors should be red-500 with clear text below inputs.
Loading states must use skeletons (shadcn/skeleton), not spinners for page loads.
